question: Does one added simple meeting permit larger bounded-opening tree founders to close within four ordinary cuts, which is the least physical whole and what fresh-sign reading survives?
forbidden_inputs: No outcome-selected generation or early stopping at the first minimum. No uniform weighting by unlabelled type. A human supplied odd ending is separate from ordinary growth.
primary_observable: Two separately ranked closed whole minima, complete physical trajectories under parity and unsigned NAE, odd operator admission, both exact labelled weightings and conditionals.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Independent coloured rooted-cycle multiplicities and all six-knot tree edits and masks, physical and witnessed-end replays, single-odd named operator products and supplied-sign positive-grant example, fixed flags and fixed supply across all predecessor deletion types.
first_executable_signal: Select size six in the complete two-law decorated census and compare class and per-length multiplicities with the independent construction.
resource_budget: One CPU thread and six GiB per process, six through eight founder knots, first four full funded cuts. Register any individual >10-minute projected job before launch.
stop_rule: Classify the entire three-size founder population and each sign or bound each unresolved mass after independent attempts. Certify both ranked ordinary and admitting minimum wholes and least sources, or explicitly withhold affected minima.
decision_or_followup_rule: Report event, admission, open, stalled and inapplicable cells, exact probabilities by size and mixed source law, independent referee pending. Distinguish population proof from any all-size structural exclusion.
